readme: SETTLED RULINGS on discovery candidates - the adjudication ledger for out\hyvee-discovery.json. Written ONLY by adjudicate-discovery.ps1, which requires a named reviewer and real evidence. A candidate with an entry here never appears on the arrivals desk again: discover-hyvee.ps1 stops surfacing it and build-arrivals-docket.ps1 stops listing it. verdict 'accepted' means a human judged the product IS the commodity, and it was added to hyvee-catalog-adds.json so the daily Hy-Vee refresh prices it from the store's own API - acceptance NEVER writes a price or a board cell. verdict 'rejected' means the product is NOT the commodity; the same command also files it in known-wrong.json, which compare-deals enforces, so the row is not eligible to be priced at all. An accepted product that later proves wrong is retired the normal way, through add-known-wrong.ps1 - the ledger records what was decided, it does not outrank a later ruling.
